description: Farmers face soil depletion and water scarcity, making sustainable crop rotation difficult. RootRise addresses this with a decision-support platform providing climate-resilient crop cycles. We are planning an interactive dashboard and an algorithmic engine to analyze field conditions and recommend optimal rotations. We are thinking of using NASA Earth data—SMAP for soil moisture, MODIS/Landsat for vegetation health, GPM for rainfall patterns, and ECOSTRESS for plant water stress.
